gaps.description: ProjectCoreService and ProjectApiAdapter are not yet bound to a production async PostgreSQL ProjectRepository/composite ApiV1Service. The PostgreSQL schema and integration invariants exist, but apps/api does not freeze the required persistence dependency set.

POST /projects accepts the NODE-11 Idempotency-Key contract, but ProjectApiAdapter does not yet persist/replay the key through idempotency_operations. Production binding must make project creation retry-safe.
project_summaries schema and deterministic seed/update contract exist; event-driven projector refresh for artifact_count, active_run_count and preview is not yet wired.
Canonical hosted execution is blocked while GitHub Actions cannot allocate runners because of the repository owner's payment/spending-limit condition.
